definition: Facebook AI Research — Meta’s AI research lab (now largely FAIR within Meta AI), known for PyTorch, self-supervised learning, and open-source models like LLaMA.
details: Facebook AI Research — Meta’s AI research lab (now largely FAIR within Meta AI), known for PyTorch, self-supervised learning, and open-source models like LLaMA.

explainer.lead: FAIR is Meta’s AI research lab, originally called Facebook AI Research and now largely situated within Meta AI. Its work matters because tools and models such as PyTorch and LLaMA have given researchers and developers widely usable building blocks for AI.

tiers.eli5: FAIR is a team of scientists and engineers at Meta who figure out how to make computers learn. Think of it as a workshop that builds both new ideas and tools others can use, including PyTorch and LLaMA.
tiers.practitioner: Engineers encounter FAIR’s work through PyTorch for building and experimenting with models and through open-source LLaMA models. Its research also includes self-supervised learning; treat FAIR as the lab behind these projects, not as a single model or software library.
tiers.paperLevel: FAIR denotes Facebook AI Research, Meta’s AI research organization, now largely FAIR within Meta AI. Its scope includes research and artifacts such as PyTorch, self-supervised learning methods, and LLaMA rather than one formal algorithm or mathematical object.

explainer.example: A researcher can use PyTorch to build and experiment with an AI model, drawing on a tool developed by the same lab known for LLaMA and self-supervised learning research.
